test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 30 Jan 2021 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Select the combination of letters that when sequentially placed in the blanks will create a repetitive pattern.

mmnn_,_pmmnnnp_,_mnnn_,_

options.text: n, p, m, p, p, m
n, p, p, m, m, p
n, p, p, m, p, p
m, p, p, n, p, p

solution:
The given series is: mmnn_,_pmmnnnp_,_mnnn_,_**
We consider the given options:

1) n, p, m, p, p, m : mmnn__**n**____**p**__p/mmnnnp**m**/__p__mnnn__p____m__

2) n, p, p, m, m, p : mmnn__n____p__p/mmnnnp__p/____m__mnnn__m____p__

3) **n, p, p, m, p, p** : mmnn__n____p__p/mmnnnp__p/m__**mnnn__p____p__

__
 
• mmnnn____p__p repeated. 

4) m, p, p, n, p, p : mmnn__m____p__p/mmnnnpp/__n__mnnn__p____p__

We can see a pattern in the 'n, p, p, m, p, p'

Hence the correct answer is option 3)
